message_en: Capitulation-zone reading — historically two-sided. Growth scare 92 (extreme) alongside a depth extreme: XLK -14% off (63d p93); QQQ momentum-washed (IHM p10); IWM washout-turn (IHM); SOXX momentum-washed (IHM p9); MAG7 momentum-washed (IHM p5). A washout can precede a bounce about as often as a further leg down.
message_zh: 资本投降区读数——历史上双向。成长恐慌 92（极端），同时出现深度极值：XLK 回撤-14%（63日p93）；QQQ 动量深跌（IHM p10）；IWM 动量拐点洗盘（IHM）；SOXX 动量深跌（IHM p9）；MAG7 动量深跌（IHM p5）。洗盘之后反弹与再下跌概率相当。
disclaimer: Display-tier only. All may_* authority flags are False. It sits BESIDE the risk banner as context and never suppresses it.
